design.train: IBM HI-Medium (all positives + sampled negatives) + synthetic INR seeds 101-110
design.validation: 20% of training accounts (entity split) for thresholds
design.calibration: synthetic INR seeds 201-203 (isotonic regression + split-conformal, alpha=0.10)
design.test: IBM HI-Small, IBM LI-Small (separate worlds) and synthetic INR seeds 301-302

notes: All numbers are on benchmark/synthetic data; none are real-bank results.
Isolation Forest is unsupervised: its score is an anomaly score, not a probability (no Brier).
Calibration is fitted on the app's INR domain; IBM tests show how it transfers.

ibm_HI-Small.label: IBM AMLworld HI-Small (separate world, never trained on)

ibm_LI-Small.label: IBM AMLworld LI-Small (separate world, never trained on)
